course_subtitle: Welcome, little future hero, on the most enjoyable journey to learn programming with interactive blocks! Here you will create your own cartoon stories, play music, and play with pets. Open the stations and start the fun!

stations.title: Station 1: Installing the Magic Blocks
stations.desc: Learn how to drag and stack colorful code blocks on top of each other to create a tower of smart commands.
stations.story: Welcome, our little hero, to the world of PictoBlox! Programming here is very easy and fun, similar to playing cubes. We pull the blue block and install it under the yellow block so that they connect with each other with a beautiful click sound!
stations.simple: Like bricks and legos! You put a cube on top of a cube to build a house or a car, and here we put a block on top of a block to create a magic code!
stations.hint: Type in the editor: print("Blocks installed successfully") and press Run!
stations.challenge: Print the magic statement Blocks installed successfully to simulate block installation.

pills.label: Block installation
pills.code: print("The software blocks were installed successfully")

validation_rules.required_output_text: The software blocks have been installed successfully

stations.title: Station 2: Animation
stations.desc: Make your favorite cartoon character jump and move left and right on the beautiful platform!
stations.story: Pictoblox characters love to move and jump! We use the movement block (jump up) to make the object rise into the air and then land safely on the ground.
stations.simple: Like a trampoline in an amusement park! You jump up and down again and have fun with your friends!
stations.hint: Type print("The character jumps up and moves skillfully").
stations.challenge: Print the magic phrase Character Jumps Up and Moves Skill to simulate a jumping action.

pills.label: Run character jump
pills.code: print("The character jumps up and moves skillfully")

validation_rules.required_output_text: The character jumps up and moves skillfully

stations.title: Station 3: Music and Sounds
stations.desc: Add fun sounds and a beautiful soundtrack to your cartoon story to make it more fun and lively!
stations.story: Beautiful stories need sounds and music! In PictoBlox we go to the pink sounds section and choose (play the sound of the cat meowing) or install cheerful musical tones.
stations.simple: Piano costume game! You step on the buttons to bring out different tunes and sing along!
stations.challenge: Print the magic phrase Play Music and Fun Sounds to simulate sound playback.

stations.title: Station 4: Feed the Pet (Pet Game)
stations.desc: Program a cute interactive story to feed your little dog (dog food) and make him rejoice and wag his tail!
stations.story: Pets need our care! We will program an interactive story: when we click on the food dish, the dog moves towards it, eats, and then says (Thank you, my friend!).
stations.simple: Like when a cat or bird eats at home! She is happy with you and feels your love and affection for her!
stations.hint: Type print("The dog is eating and is very happy").
stations.challenge: Print the phrase The dog is eating and is very happy to simulate feeding the pet.
stations.starter_code: # Simulate the story of feeding the little dog:

pills.label: Feed the pet dog
pills.code: print("The dog eats food and is very happy")

validation_rules.required_output_text: The dog eats food and is very happy

stations.title: Station 5: Color Match
stations.desc: Make a smart color matching game, and make the platform turn the correct color when you choose the right block!
stations.story: Colors make our world beautiful! We will program a matching game: if we choose the apple, the color red appears, and if we choose the banana, the beautiful yellow color appears.
stations.simple: Magic coloring book costume! You choose the appropriate pen and color the tree green and the sun yellow to create an artistic painting!
stations.challenge: Print the magic sentence Match colors 100% correct to simulate a color game.

stations.title: Station 6: The Great Balloon Popping Challenge
stations.desc: The grand final stop! Programming the game of popping colorful balloons that fly in the sky and celebrating the hero's victory!
stations.story: The grand finale stop at Junior Pictoblox! We will simulate programming a balloon popping game. The balloons fly up, and when we tap them they explode with a funny "pop" sound and we collect stars!
stations.simple: Like a balloon popping game for Eid! You hit the balloon and pop it, and you win the game and the gift!
stations.hint: Type print("The balloon popping game has been played and the little hero wins!").
stations.challenge: Print the closing phrase The balloon popping game has been played and the little hero has won! to celebrate the completion of your first game story!
stations.starter_code: # Run the closing balloon game simulation:

pills.label: Big balloon popping
pills.code: print("The balloon popping game has been played and the little hero has won!")

validation_rules.required_output_text: The balloon popping game has been played and the little hero wins!
